Selecting the appropriate garden hose for your specific needs is essential for maintaining healthy lawns and gardens. Our product portfolio is designed to meet a variety of requirements, ensuring quality and reliability for both residential and professional use.

Garden Hose and Watering Equipment: Quality, Variety, and Expertise
#

Hung Ta is a seasoned manufacturer and exporter specializing in garden hoses and watering solutions. With an annual production exceeding 1,000,000 garden hoses, we serve the international horticultural market by delivering products that combine premium materials, reliable quality, and efficient lead times. Our commitment is to provide cost-effective solutions for all shipments, ensuring satisfaction for clients worldwide.
